lines.text: Thanks for joining. I am the procurement lead for the clinic group.
lines.name: Rina

lines.text: Happy to be here. We help clinics move their booking to one shared calendar.
Our security officer will not accept a tool that stores patient names outside the country.
lines.name: Rina

lines.text: That is fair. Our data stays in a regional data center, and I can send you the hosting document.
Please do. And what is the yearly price for twelve clinics?
lines.name: Rina

lines.text: For twelve clinics the yearly price is 14400 dollars, billed once.
That is above our budget of 12000 for this year.
lines.name: Rina

lines.text: I can look at a smaller first stage with six clinics and come back to you with a number.
Good. We decided to run the security review first, before any pilot.
lines.name: Rina

lines.text: Who on your side signs the data processing agreement?
lines.name: Rina

lines.text: I will send the hosting document and the agreement draft by Tuesday.

promises.what: send the hosting document and agreement draft by Tuesday
